name: Oracle Rumbler
body:
Like the deafening sound of thunder, a rumbler’s magic is concussive, capable of stunning and toppling its targets.

A rumbler has the following class features.

Mystery

A rumbler must select the wind mystery.

Bonus Spells

Windy escape (2nd), distressing tone (4th), greater thunderstomp (6th), thundering drums (8th), discordant blast (10th), sonic form (12th), scouring winds (14th), resonating word (16th).

These bonus spells replace the oracle’s mystery bonus spells at these levels.

Concussive Attacks (Ex)

A rumbler must select the thunderburst revelation at 7th level. Furthermore, a rumbler can select the following revelations in place of a wind mystery revelation:

Booming Spells (Ex)

You gain your choice of Concussive Spell or Echoing Spell as a bonus metamagic feat. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

Reverberating Magic (Ex)

After a creature suffers damage from a spell with the sonic descriptor that you cast, you can, as a swift action, cause the magic to reverberate upon that creature. (If the spell you cast damages more than one creature simultaneously, you must select a single creature to be the recipient of this ability.) The selected creature takes 1/2 the amount of damage originally inflicted by your spell and must make a Fortitude saving throw (DC = 10 + 1/2 your oracle level + your Charisma modifier), or be stunned for 1 round. You can use this ability once per day, plus one additional time at 15th and 19th level. You must be at least 11th level to select this revelation.

This alters revelations.
